**npm test verdict independent of BRAIN_MEMORY_UPSTREAM_REF**

Four test files (upstream-records.integration, supersedes.integration, staged-records-check.integration, cli.save-search) drove the real unstubbed upstream-ref predicate or spawned a real CLI child without neutralising the ambient BRAIN_MEMORY_UPSTREAM_REF env var, so npm test's verdict depended on the developer shell (8 fail under the polluted env, measured vs the issue's 4). Fixed by neutralising the var per call site (withoutEnv, env: {}, or a stripped spawn-env snapshot) with no production code changes; withoutEnv promoted to a shared fixture scripts/memory/__fixtures__/env.mjs. Both directions proven equal at 5277/5277, and each fix mutation-tested independently.
